remarks: Beautifully maintained, this charming ranch-style home offers four bedrooms and three full bathrooms in an unbeatable location. Just a short walk to vibrant downtown Westport, you'll enjoy the perfect blend of convenience and tranquility.  Step outside to a peaceful, partially fenced backyard featuring tasteful landscaping and a spacious wraparound deck-ideal for relaxing, entertaining, or enjoying the outdoors. Additional highlights include a whole-house generator for added peace of mind. With so much to offer, this is a home you won't want to miss. No disclosure, this home is part of a trust. No probate involved. The trustee has decided to ask for highest and best offer by Saturday July 11th, 6pm. All offers will be then reviewed and decision made by Sunday July 12th.
